ratios.facility: Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement
ratios.quote: As of September 30, 2026, our Consolidated Leverage Ratio was approximately 3.60 to 1.00 versus our maximum covenant of 4.25 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: Covenant maximum was raised by the July 29, 2025 amendment: 4.75x for Q1–Q2 2026 and 4.25x for Q3–Q4 2026. It then reverts to 4.50x for Q1–Q2 and 4.00x for Q3–Q4. The pricing grid tiers based on the Consolidated Leverage Ratio only set rates and fees, so they are excluded; pricing is fixed at Tier 1 through December 31, 2026. The same ratio and limit appear in both the notes and the MD&A, so they are reported once.
